Help & Online Storage

Use the username your teacher assigned to open your workspace. Your programs, goals, and exercise progressions save online. If a save is interrupted, keep the workspace open and use Retry when the connection returns.

To compare two plans for one exercise, open an athlete in Program Builder and choose Add Alternative Progression on the exercise. Both plans share the same goal.

In Anatomy Zone, choose a body movement or an exercise to see Johnny demonstrate it. Drag the slider to inspect a position, or choose Play to watch the movement.

Use Export Work in Program Builder to download the current workspace. A teacher can use Export Online Workspaces for all program workspaces. Download PDFs separately in Library Zone.
